Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And subdue my desire for all that is forbidden
And turn my greed away from all sins

Arabic text: وَامْنَعْنِيْ عَنْ أَذَى كُلِّ مُؤْمِنٍ وَمُؤْمِنَةٍ وَمُسْلِمٍ وَمُسْلِمَةٍ
Translation: And prevent me from harming any believing man or woman, any Muslim man or woman

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ وَأَيُّمَا عَبْدٍ نَالَ مِنِّيْ مَا حَظَرْتَ عَلَيْهِ
Translation: O Allah, whichever servant has taken from me what You have forbidden him
And violated what You have barred him from me
And has passed away while still oppressing me
Or is still alive while I have rights over him

Arabic text: فَاغْفِرْ لَهُ مَا أَلَمَّ بِهِ مِنِّي
Translation: Forgive him for what he has done against me

Arabic text: وَاعْفُ لَهُ عَمَّا أَدْبَرَ بِهِ عَنِّي
Translation: And pardon him for what he has turned away from me

Arabic text: وَلَا تَقِفْهُ عَلَى مَا ارْتَكَبَ فِيَّ
Translation: And do not hold him accountable for what he has committed against me
And do not expose what he has earned by wronging me

Arabic text: وَاجْعَلْ مَا سَمَحْتُ بِهِ مِنَ الْعَفْوِ عَنْهُمْ
Translation: And make my lenient forgiveness towards them
And my voluntary charity upon them
The purest of all charities of those who give charity
And the highest of all connections of those who seek nearness to You
And compensate me for my forgiveness of them with Your forgiveness
And for my prayers for them with Your mercy

Arabic text: حَتَّى يَسْعَدَ كُلُّ وَاحِدٍ مِنَّا بِفَضْلِكَ
Translation: So that each one of us may be blessed by Your grace
And each of us may be saved by Your favor
O Allah, whichever of Your servants

Arabic text: أَدْرَكَهُ مِنِّيْ دَرَكٌ أَوْ مَسَّهُ مِنْ نَاحِيَتِيْ أَذًى
Translation: Has suffered harm from me or been hurt by me in any way

Arabic text: أَوْ لَحِقَهُ بِيْ أَوْ بِسَبَبِيْ ظُلْمٌ
Translation: Or has been wronged by me or because of me
And I have deprived him of his right
Or I have preceded him in oppression
Then send blessings upon Muhammad and his family

Arabic text: وَأَرْضِهِ عَنِّيْ مِنْ وُجْدِكَ وَأَوْفِهِ حَقَّهُ مِنْ عِنْدِكَ
Translation: And satisfy him with me from Your wealth and fulfill his right from Your presence

Arabic text: ثُمَّ قِنِيْ مَا يُوجِبُ لَهُ حُكْمُكَ
Translation: Then protect me from what Your judgment requires for him
And save me from what Your justice decrees
For my strength cannot withstand Your vengeance
And my power cannot rise against Your displeasure
For if You repay me with justice, You will destroy me
And unless You shelter me with Your mercy, You will ruin me

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلٰهِيْ مَا لَا يُنْقِصُكَ بَذْلُهُ
Translation: O Allah, I ask You, my God, to grant what does not decrease when You give it
And I ask You to bear what does not burden You to carry

Arabic text: أَسْتَوْهِبُكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ نَفْسِيَ الَّتِيْ لَمْ تَخْلُقْهَا لِتَمْتَنِعَ بِهَا مِنْ سُوءٍ
Translation: I ask You, my God, for my soul which You did not create to protect itself from evil
Or to attain benefit on its own

Arabic text: وَلَكِنْ أَنْشَأْتَهَا إِثْبَاتًا لِقُدْرَتِكَ عَلَى مِثْلِهَا
Translation: But You created it as a proof of Your power over its like
And as an argument against its similar forms

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَحْمِلُكَ مِنْ ذُنُوبِيْ مَا قَدْ بَهَظَنِيْ حَمْلُهُ
Translation: And I ask You to bear my sins which have overburdened me

Arabic text: وَأَسْتَعِينُ بِكَ عَلَى مَا قَدْ فَدَحَنِيْ ثِقْلُهُ
Translation: And I seek Your help with what has weighed heavily upon me
So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family
And grant my soul despite its wrongdoing
And entrust Your mercy to bear my burden
For how often has Your mercy reached the wrongdoers
And how often has Your pardon encompassed the oppressors

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَاجْعَلْنِيْ أُسْوَةَ مَنْ قَدْ أَنْهَضْتَهُ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family and make me an example of one whom You have raised
By Your forgiveness from the downfalls of the sinners
And whom You have saved by Your guidance from the entanglements of the criminals

Arabic text: فَأَصْبَحَ طَلِيقَ عَفْوِكَ مِنْ إِسَارِ سُخْطِكَ
Translation: So that he became freed by Your pardon from the captivity of Your anger
And liberated by Your doing from the bonds of Your justice

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ إِنْ تَفْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ تَفْعَلْهُ بِمَنْ
Translation: If You do that, my God, You will be doing it for one
Who does not deny deserving Your punishment

Arabic text: وَلَا يُبَرِّئُ نَفْسَهُ مِنِ اسْتِيجَابِ نَقِمَتِكَ
Translation: And does not absolve himself from meriting Your vengeance

Arabic text: تَفْعَلُ ذٰلِكَ يَا إِلَهِيْ بِمَنْ خَوْفُهُ مِنْكَ أَكْثَرُ مِنْ طَمَعِهِ فِيكَ
Translation: You will be doing that, my God, for one whose fear of You is greater than his hope in You

Arabic text: وَبِمَنْ يَأْسُهُ مِنَ النَّجَاةِ أَوْكَدُ مِنْ رَجَائِهِ لِلْخَلَاصِ
Translation: And whose despair of salvation is stronger than his expectation of deliverance
Not that his despair is desperation
Or that his hope is deception
But because his good deeds are few among his bad deeds
And his arguments are weak in all his accountabilities

Arabic text: فَأَمَّا أَنْتَ يَا إِلَهِيْ فَأَهْلٌ أَنْ
Translation: But You, my God, are worthy that
The truthful should not be deceived about You
And the sinners should not despair of You

Arabic text: لِأَنَّكَ الرَّبُّ الْعَظِيمُ الَّذِيْ لَا يَمْنَعُ أَحَدًا فَضْلَهُ
Translation: For You are the Magnificent Lord who does not withhold His bounty from anyone
And does not demand full payment of His due from anyone
Exalted is Your mention above all who are mentioned
And sanctified are Your names above all who are attributed
And Your blessings have spread among all created beings

Arabic text: فَلَكَ الْحَمْدُ عَلَى ذٰلِكَ يَا رَبَّ الْعَالَمِيْنَ
Translation: So to You belongs all praise for that, O Lord of the Worlds
